# Al-Hadaf Metal Coating LLC

> Best powder coating in UAE from Al-Hadaf Metal Coating LLC, Industrial Area 15, Near National Paints, Sharjah. Powder coating, sandblasting, galvanizing, electroplating, tin plating, gold/silver plating and antique finishes for architectural, industrial, automotive and furniture metal across Sharjah, Dubai, Ajman and Abu Dhabi. Established 2022, 15+ years of coating experience.
